body: Raised P2 -> P1 on the suggestion of PR #911's high-tier review (https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/911#pullrequestreview-5868416850): on a reduced-fidelity model the collision laws (shank / holder reach, rapids in stock, the turning rapid, bar-feed and holder scans) are not yet tightened and can read up to 0.01 mm too generous on a convex wall while an operation still posts. Other review notes for this issue: a stock copied from a coarse model loses its flag once that model is deleted; near the refusal edge the program sim can show a false gouge line instead of the named refusal; a project saved before #911 with an over-budget mesh loads as full fidelity with no re-check; "re-import with a larger budget" names a setting that does not exist yet.

Issue sweep: already done on main: `27b5e0406` (PR #1064), `ec57632d6` (PR #1074), `f72b88a02` (PR #1081), `a0d102834` (PR #1127), `8864176cb` (PR #1341), `cf9ff14ee` (PR #1755), `bac4a96c7` (PR #2904).

- Part (1) turning, rotary, and multi-axis ball kinds: `crates/app/src/operation/fidelity_law.rs` enables them with tightened laws (`27b5e0406`). `crates/motion/tests/turning_coarse.rs`, `crates/app/src/operation/rotary_law_tests.rs`, and `crates/app/tests/coarse_laws.rs` pin them.
- Part (1) probe, plasma, and cross drill: `crates/app/src/operation/fidelity_law.rs` enables them with tightened laws (`f72b88a02`, `cf9ff14ee`). `crates/app/tests/coarse_probe_plasma.rs` and `crates/app/tests/coarse_cross_drill.rs` pin them.
- Part (1) cone rides, engrave rides, and swarf: `crates/app/src/operation/fidelity_law.rs` keeps them refused for stated reasons (`27b5e0406`, `f72b88a02`). `crates/app/tests/coarse_laws.rs` (`every_kind_is_either_judged_or_refused_for_a_stated_reason_on_a_reduced_model`) pins this. Open issue #1052 tracks the separate enhancement for swarf flank verification.
- Part (2) collision laws: `crates/sim/src/verify/reach.rs`, `rapids.rs`, `rapids_posed.rs`, `rapids_radial.rs`, and `crates/app/src/operation/turning_rapids.rs` grow their bands by the excess (`27b5e0406`, `cf9ff14ee`). `crates/sim/tests/coarse_collision.rs`, `crates/app/src/operation/turning_rapids_tests.rs`, and `crates/app/tests/coarse_cross_drill.rs` pin them.
- Part (3) metre-unit STEP: `crates/app/src/geometry/import/step.rs` reads metre files in millimetres at the 0.005 mm chord cap (`bac4a96c7`). `crates/app/tests/model_fidelity.rs` (`an_inch_step_and_a_metre_step_are_full_fidelity_by_measure`) and `crates/geometry/tests/step_metre_unit.rs` (`a_metre_step_meshes_at_the_cap_with_a_measured_deviation`) pin this.
- Part (4) facet budget setting: `crates/app/src/geometry/import/step_budget.rs`, the import dialog, the script verb, and MCP `import_model` expose the budget (`ec57632d6`). `crates/app/tests/step_budget.rs` pins this.
- Part (5) display tolerances and PR #911 notes: stock copies keep their flag, the named refusal wins over sim gouges, display colours use the tightened tolerance, and pre-v59 meshes load as unknown fidelity (`a0d102834`, `8864176cb`). `crates/app/tests/fidelity_copies.rs` pins this.
- Part (6) envelope law (f) and containment solid law: `crates/sim/tests/model_excess.rs` (`the_envelope_laws_gouge_half_answers_to_the_tolerance_less_the_excess`) and `crates/app/tests/coarse_contain.rs` (`a_drill_past_a_blind_floor_by_less_than_the_excess_is_a_gouge_on_a_reduced_model`) pin them (`27b5e0406`).
